objective: Consolidate missing approved Nov 19 UI and reader updates into the exact Genesis 2.0 preview native ancestor without propagating unverified native changes or activating locked rewards. Exact source change includes avatar rank, permanent Notes, KL dictionary, Bible rubric and secure admin registration inbox, plus lazy read-only approved ten-feature and full BP/QMP/two-track encyclopedias.

chosenApproach: Carefully port only stage-reviewed and non-mutating source hunks; avoid copying entire divergent branch. Account-scoped rank RPC read-only, preserve existing 40 badge atlas. Fail-close preview-only content; no new backend writes or entitlement.
selectionRationale: Fix confirmed source-to-APK omission while preserving working source assets, ad navigation, auth and approved Genesis season identity. Keep backend-gated features separate.
